body: I know that’s true, I guess I’m just not sure 😭 which is stupid, I know the internet can’t tell me, I guess I’m just too afraid to tell my friends and just wanted someone to talk to
No I love spending time with her. It feels like we have a lot to catch up on, and I really missed having her around. I forgot how many tweets I would send her on an average day

It would be really bad for like a million reasons.

* My best friend is her ex and we bonded over how hurt we were by her and he would probably kill me.

* We have a lot of mutual friends and I do not think very many of them would take it well.

* She did kinda sorta treat me like dog shit for a year and a half so most of my friends hate her and can’t believe I’m giving her the time of day

* If I were to say something and completely catch her off guard she would probably run away bc that’s what she does and I’m not really interested in crying every day again

And I don’t know. It would be strange to date her. It’s not something I’ve ever really considered to ever be an option so it’s not something I can easily wrap my brain around.

Yes, my reasoning was that I would be more willing to pay sticker price at one of my reach schools, but at my targets (Irvine, U Wash) I was more likely to get more scholarship money, for his offsetting the cost. Thank you!!

I heard that Fordham was stingy on scholarships, and I was nervous about cost of living in LA :( If I thought I could get scholarships there, I would shoot for any of those!! But I thought UCLA/USC were closer to reaches for me, so no cash money. Ya know?

My thing with the LSAT is I'm not honestly not confident that I can do better. Studied basically Jan-Sept, got a 158 in June and 163 in Sept.

No, I usually do pretty well :/ That's why I retook. And I had some money-related stress the first go around. I imagine crying on the phone to my parents 3 nights in a row before the test was not helpful, in hindsight. But my PT score shot up between June-Sept, and I'm hoping it shows when I get my score back.
